Thank you for taking part in the Griffith University study *Can a mattress topper preserve nocturnal autonomic function in older adults during summer?* (GU Ref No: HREC/2026/0662).

This website has the same instructions as the printed booklets in your pack, plus short videos showing each step. Use whichever you find easier — or both.

::: {.callout-note title="What is in your pack"}
- A **Fitbit Inspire 3** tracker, charging cable, power adapter and a larger band
- A **bedroom temperature sensor** with its base station, cables and a spare battery
- A **mattress topper** (the Kiva Circadian Sleep Pod®) with its control unit — this arrives separately, in summer, when we tell you it is time
:::

## What to do, and when

| When | What | Guide |
|------|------|-------|
| As soon as your pack arrives | Set up the Fitbit and wear it every night | [Fitbit set-up](fitbit.qmd) |
| As soon as your pack arrives | Connect the base station and stick the sensor on your bedroom wall | [Temperature sensor set-up](temperature-sensor.qmd) |
| In summer, when we call you | Fit the mattress topper to your bed | [Mattress topper set-up](mattress-topper.qmd) |
| When we tell you the study has finished | Post the equipment back to us | [Returning your equipment](returning-equipment.qmd) |

## A few things that matter for the whole study

- **Keep the Google Health app installed and stay signed in** with the study login. If you sign out, we stop receiving your readings.
- **Leave the base station plugged in and switched on**, day and night.
- **Charge the Fitbit during the day**, not overnight, so it is on your wrist while you sleep.

## Stuck?

Please call us — we would much rather help than have you guess. Details are on the [Need a hand?](contact.qmd) page.
